name: Compassion
overview: Scripture reveals compassion as a deeply divine attribute, demonstrated by God's tender care for humanity, as seen in His grieving over mankind in Genesis 6:6 and His unfailing mercies in Lamentations 3:22. God's compassion is likened to a father's pity for his children (Psalms 103:13), highlighting a personal and loving relationship. Christ exemplifies this compassion through His response to the needy multitudes, moved to heal the sick and teach those like sheep without a shepherd (Matthew 9:36; 14:14; Mark 6:34), showing that compassion is both an expression of divine love and an active ministry toward others.
